barcelonaSpecificPathsRequired.why: The PGM packs are registered under jurisdictionId 'es-08019-barcelona' with BARCELONA_BBOX. resolveRegisteredJurisdictionAt(lat,lon) would route 85 parcels here only because that bbox is declared 'metropolitan' and happens to contain them — the pack's citations would then be Barcelona's.

Arts. 239/320.3a/327.2a/328.2a are read from MPGM 02-03-2007, DOGC 4893, whose own scope is «al terme municipal de Barcelona». It does NOT govern SANT CLIMENT DE LLOBREGAT. Publishing this pack's numbers here would cite an instrument that does not apply.

Arts. 342/343 are read from MPGM 20-10-2004, DOGC 4277, whose own scope is «l'ordenació de l'edificació aïllada, de Barcelona». It does NOT govern SANT CLIMENT DE LLOBREGAT. Publishing this pack's numbers here would cite an instrument that does not apply.

Arts. 306 are read from hardcoded CODI_INE='08019' in the resolver's own WHERE clause, whose own scope is «Barcelona only, by construction». It does NOT govern SANT CLIMENT DE LLOBREGAT. Publishing this pack's numbers here would cite an instrument that does not apply.

The resolver hardcodes CODI_INE='08019' in its WHERE clause, so it returns 'no-feature' for every parcel here. Additionally apps/editor/src/ui/site/siteDispatch.ts:4146 guards the branch to clau exactly '18'.

heightFromFloorsAboveGround() converts storeys->metres using BCN_ALCADA_REGULADORA_TABLE, the Art. 327.2a ladder AS MODIFIED FOR BARCELONA. The base metropolitan ladder that governs other AMB municipalities is present as BCN_ART327_BASE_METROPOLITAN_TABLE but NOTHING READS IT.

barcelonaSpecificPathsRequired.why: The PGM packs are registered under jurisdictionId 'es-08019-barcelona' with BARCELONA_BBOX. resolveRegisteredJurisdictionAt(lat,lon) would route 93 parcels here only because that bbox is declared 'metropolitan' and happens to contain them — the pack's citations would then be Barcelona's.

Arts. 239/320.3a/327.2a/328.2a are read from MPGM 02-03-2007, DOGC 4893, whose own scope is «al terme municipal de Barcelona». It does NOT govern SANTA COLOMA DE GRAMENET. Publishing this pack's numbers here would cite an instrument that does not apply.

Arts. 342/343 are read from MPGM 20-10-2004, DOGC 4277, whose own scope is «l'ordenació de l'edificació aïllada, de Barcelona». It does NOT govern SANTA COLOMA DE GRAMENET. Publishing this pack's numbers here would cite an instrument that does not apply.

Arts. 306 are read from hardcoded CODI_INE='08019' in the resolver's own WHERE clause, whose own scope is «Barcelona only, by construction». It does NOT govern SANTA COLOMA DE GRAMENET. Publishing this pack's numbers here would cite an instrument that does not apply.

The resolver hardcodes CODI_INE='08019' in its WHERE clause, so it returns 'no-feature' for every parcel here. Additionally apps/editor/src/ui/site/siteDispatch.ts:4146 guards the branch to clau exactly '18'.

heightFromFloorsAboveGround() converts storeys->metres using BCN_ALCADA_REGULADORA_TABLE, the Art. 327.2a ladder AS MODIFIED FOR BARCELONA. The base metropolitan ladder that governs other AMB municipalities is present as BCN_ART327_BASE_METROPOLITAN_TABLE but NOTHING READS IT.
